name: Toll of the Bell
source:
A new peaceful life outside of the hustle and bustle of the City is all that you want.  When a deal for an apartment outside of the City opens up there's no doubt you took it.

Welsoton, a historic town with rich history, the buildings kept pristine.  Like a page right out of a history book.  The town's famous landmark, the bell tower, still rings to this day, marking every hour without fail.

A mystery, a murder?

Meet an interesting group of characters as you discover What's really happening under this guise of a quiet town.

[From [url=https://errantimarum.itch.io/toll-of-the-bell]Itch.io[/url]]
